what: The fifteen turns the master plan D001-26003-03 labels on the track (T1 to T15), read at the centre of each label on the drawing as the page holds it (MAP_TILES level 0, 5200 x 3673 px; the same frame as the D001 sheet markers and MASTER_LAYERS). Read by eye on 2x crops with a 20 px grid, about +/- 3 px (about 1 m). Each label sits on the carriageway at its corner.
